vtep_logical_switch_uuid.description: UUID of the VTEP logical switch to manage (must exist in OVN NB DB)

vtep_physical_interface.description: Name of the Linux network interface used for VTEP tunnel endpoints

vtep_physical_ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address to bind VTEP tunnels to (typically the IP of vtep_physical_interface)

vtep_enabled.description: Enable VTEP functionality on this controller

max_vtep_connections.description: Maximum number of VTEP connections (tunnels) to maintain

max_tunnel_key.description: Upper limit for VNI (tunnel key) allocation (must be ≤ 16777215)

nb_db_connection.description: Connection string to OVN Northbound database (format: <protocol>:<host>:<port>)

sb_db_connection.description: Connection string to OVN Southbound database (format: <protocol>:<host>:<port>)

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS database connection (leave empty to disable TLS)

tls_cert.description: Path to server certificate for TLS (required if TLS enabled)

tls_private_key.description: Path to server private key for TLS (required if TLS enabled)

ssl_enable.description: Enable SSL/TLS for database connections (requires certificate files if true)

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (one of: info, debug, err, warn)

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' for stdout, empty for default)

vtep_physical_networks.description: List of additional physical network mappings (beyond the main interface)

interface.description: Linux interface name to bind this network to

external_ids.description: Key-value pairs to attach as external IDs to the VTEP logical switch in OVN databases
